## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector leadership (Energy, Financials, Materials positive vs Technology, Healthcare, Real Estate negative) and leadership concentration is mixed (Top 5 span 3 sectors), so no clear directional bias; style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +9.38%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +10.69%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +4.49%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.93% | 1M: +0.96%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing rotation: PPG (1W: +5.86% | 1M: -15.02%) RECOVERY, DD (1W: +5.30% | 1M: -8.92%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Real Estate weak: AMT (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -12.05%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -9.36% | 1M: -12.09%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak: VST (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -11.60%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -36.39%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.43% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +19.62%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +5.86% | 1M: -15.02%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +5.69% | 1M: -2.27%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors represented in Top 5: Energy, Technology, Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: GOOGL (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.36%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -5.47% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -12.05%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -11.60%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -36.39%) BELOW TREND; weakness is cross‑sector and concentrated in defensive Real Estate/Staples and select Communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.43% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +5.69% | 1M: -2.27%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence across several large caps (AAPL, JPM, V, JNJ showing 1W up vs 1M down) — tactical signal to watch for trend confirmation and potential short‑term reversals.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed, leaning soft with clear bifurcation: AMD (1W: +10.43% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND and CSCO (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.36%) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 8/24 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Constructive but mixed: C (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +4.49%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.93% | 1M: +0.96%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY and WFC (1W: +5.34% | 1M: -5.10%) RECOVERY. Financials breadth: 13/20 positive (Sector Strength) — Financials favored in the current mix.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Cautionary: JNJ (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -0.47%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -0.19% | 1M: -12.08%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.52%) CORRECTION. Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive (Internal Rotation) — defensive names are mixed, watch earnings/news catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials and Energy exposure (C (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +4.49%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +9.38%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to lagging Real Estate and staples (AMT (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -12.05%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -36.39%) BELOW TREND); style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a mixed market, but monitor major divergences for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND (news +55) and AMAT (1W: +5.69% | 1M: -2.27%) RECOVERY (news +60) for follow‑through. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.36%) BELOW TREND (news -75) and META (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -6.87%) BELOW TREND (news -75) as headline risk remains.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (8/10 positive, Sector Strength) and Financials (13/20 positive, Sector Strength) for cyclical leadership. BEARISH: Real Estate (1/10 positive, Sector Weakness) and Consumer Staples (3/14 positive, Sector Weakness) for continued pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND — a sustained break above short‑term resistance would signal regime shift in Tech. Watch AAPL (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -7.17%) RECOVERY for confirmation of a broader bounce; monitor JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY and XOM (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +9.38%) ABOVE TREND for Financials/Energy continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
SLB (+55): SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND — news on multi‑well EPC contract confirms price strength (sentiment and price confirming). AMAT (+60): AMAT (1W: +5.69% | 1M: -2.27%) RECOVERY — record DRAM tools/dividend hike headline is supporting the 1W momentum (sentiment confirmed).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
GOOGL (-75): GOOGL (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.36%) BELOW TREND — legal headlines are matched by price weakness (sentiment and price confirming). META (-75): META (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -6.87%) BELOW TREND — similar headline pressure with confirming downside action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SLB (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.43% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND and C (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +4.49%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is headline‑driven divergence in large caps (GOOGL/META negative sentiment; AAPL/JPM/V showing 1W vs 1M splits) — monitor for confirmation before enlarging cyclical exposure.
